description: 10-year historical climate averages (2015-2024, ERA5 reanalysis) for a point. Pass month 1-12 for that month's climatology with min and max ranges: accumulations (precipitation, snowfall, evaporation, radiation) are then totals for that month, for example precipitation_mm in mm/month. Omit month for the annual climate: accumulations are then annual totals (mm/year, MJ/m2/year). Evaporation is positive (water evaporated). Use this for questions about typical climate, growing seasons, or what weather to expect at a location and time of year. The response's units object gives each value's unit and time basis.

month.description: Optional month 1-12. Omit it for the annual climate

name: get_historical_climate
